description: This file defines a Smarty plugin function for capitalizing words within strings. It includes a main function 'smarty_modifier_capitalize' that applies capitalization to each word and a helper function 'smarty_modifier_capitalize_ucfirst' for specific character-based capitalization logic.

methods.name: smarty_modifier_capitalize
methods.description: Applies capitalization to each word in a string using a regular expression and a callback function.

methods.name: smarty_modifier_capitalize_ucfirst
methods.description: Capitalizes the first character of a string based on certain conditions, considering digits and apostrophes.
